purpose: Gate 7. Adversarial out-of-domain and transfer questions. Not contaminated in the way the regression set is: these were written to probe the guard, and the correct answer for each is a BEHAVIOUR (refuse / pass through), not a document the semantic graph was built around.
scoring: domain=out_of_domain scores correct iff the system refuses. domain=transfer scores correct iff it passes through labelled as TRANSFER_REQUEST. domain=in_domain is a control that must NOT be refused.
